description: Affordance-classification probes (qc01.2) — widgets the surfer may misclassify or fail to actuate: file upload, range slider, date picker, multi-select, ARIA toggle switch (role=switch div, NOT a checkbox), HTML5 drag-and-drop. Each writes its value to /widgets/result for an independent DOM oracle.

scenarios.goal: Log in, go to /widgets/file, attach any file in the file input, and click Upload.
Log in, go to /widgets/slider, set the Level range slider to 70, and click Save.
Log in, go to /widgets/date, set the date field to 2026-03-15, and click Save.
Log in, go to /widgets/multiselect, select BOTH 'Red' and 'Blue' in the multi-select list, and click Save.
Log in, go to /widgets/toggle, turn the toggle switch ON, and click Save.
Log in, go to /widgets/drag, drag the 'Item' box into the 'Drop here' zone, and click Save.
